what: Mapping of WeBuddhist liturgy texts from the old production MongoDB to the new OpenPecha v2 backend ids carried in this vault's note frontmatter.

old_backend.identifier: Text.pecha_text_id (Text._id is the UUID that Segment.text_id and TableOfContent.text_id reference)

method: Content join. Old segment text was rebuilt per Text doc in TableOfContent order and normalised (whitespace + Tibetan punctuation stripped), then compared with each note body (frontmatter, headings and ^N block ids stripped) using difflib with autojunk disabled. Titles could not be used as a key: 1-SOURCES was renamed to full titles, so only 2 of 94 note titles still match the old catalog, and Mongo titles carry ornamental prefixes. Every result was cross-checked by a second, independent method: probing Segment.content with regex for distinctive lines from each note. The two methods agree exactly on which notes have a counterpart - the 86 mapped notes all score >=0.80 content similarity, and the 8 unmapped ones all score <0.50 and return zero segment hits.

match_method_values.content-probe: confirmed by distinctive-line search in Segment.content
